title: Hanasato Minori — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Minori's birthday
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's time for Minori Hanasato's Special Birthday Livestream♪

rows.Speaker: Airi, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Minori!>
<Happy birthday!>
<Minori!!! We're here to celebrate!!!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Thank you all!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And thank you for your messages on social media too! I'm reading all of them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She was scrolling nonstop before the stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And she had such a bright smile on her face too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I mean, it just makes me so happy to think of all the people who are supporting me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, hey! Don't move into the emotional climax already!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've only just started the stream!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, Airi's right. We have to celebrate properly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The truth is, we have a special stream planned just for today, which Minori knows nothing about.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's right! We call it...
The Heart-Thumping Present Quiz!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Here it is, the special segment!>
<A quiz?>
<I wonder how it'll work.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll put our presents for Minori into this special box, and then she'll feel them and try to guess what each one is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to guess using only my hands? That sounds hard! But I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but, if I don't guess what they are, does that mean I don't get the presents?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you're starting to understand the soul of variety entertainment, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! So you mean...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, don't tease her... Don't worry, Minori. This is your celebration, so of course you'll get your gifts.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if you guess wrong, there might be a penalty or two.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: P-P-Penalty?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think you're teasing her more than me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. There won't be any takebacks or penalties at all, so just have fun and enjoy it, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, thank goodness! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, we'll start with Airi's present.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. I'll put it in the box now, so close your eyes, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One side of the box is open so all of you watching can see what's inside, but don't spoil the surprise by telling her, okay?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Okay!>
<I see, I see. So that's what it is.>
<Can't wait to see Minori's reaction.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, all set! You can look now, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay, here I go! It's a little scary putting my hand inside a box I can't see inside...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it's a present from Airi, so it can't be anything scary, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm, I wonder?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! What's that smile for?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, what is it...aah! Something moved!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure you didn't just nudge it with your hand?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh, right. Okay, let's try again... Huh? It's kind of fluffy?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah! Is it one of those fluffy stick things you use for dusting?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not really a birthday present type of thing, is it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I guess not...
Hmm, what could it be?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. To give you a hint...
I'd say...it's something you love a lot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something I love a lot...hm? Wait, this shape... Is it a doggy?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I got it! It's a dog plushie!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ding ding ding♪
That's right! Go ahead and look inside!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, it's a Samoyed plushie! And it looks just like Samo!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I found this at a general store while looking for presents. And even I was surprised by just how much it looks like him.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi! I bet Samo will be happy too! I'll take great care of it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Please do. Happy birthday, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, let's get the next present ready...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, that's all for the Heart-Thumping Present Quiz.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori managed to get all three presents right. Everyone say congratulations...and happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Minori!!!>
<Congrats! That was fun!>
<Good thing they didn't prank you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone! It was a bit scary, but I had lots of fun! And I love all the presents!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed yourself. Well, everyone... I'm sorry to say, but it's just about time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Minori, do you want to lead off—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, before I do that, can I have a little bit of everyone's time?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think that's fine, but what's up?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've actually prepared something myself!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, Airi, Shizuku. And everyone else who's watching. Thank you all so much for today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You've given me the best birthday ever! So, um... I want to give something back!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, I've actually written a thank-you letter!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll read it now. Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Dear Airi. Thank you for everything. You're always so collected, and you guide us along. I feel like I always rely on you for everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I want to be reliable for you when you need help, too. I'll do my best to get better. Let's keep on working together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Dear Shizuku. Thank you for everything. I really love how gentle you are and how relaxing it is to be around you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll work hard to become a gentle and cool idol just like you, so I hope you'll teach me everything I need to know!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Dear Haruka. Thank you for everything. When I was starting out, you were my hero... And you still are today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I plan to keep chasing after you, so I can get even a little closer to being a sparkling, wonderful idol like you. Let's keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And to all the fans who support me every day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you all so, so much for cheering me on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm an idol today because of all of you. Your voices are what make me an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I still mess up a lot, but I'll keep on spreading hope to everyone I can! So please, keep watching over me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Signed, Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Minori>
<I'll always support you.>
<We're with you forever!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, that was quite a surprise waiting at the end...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. That was a wonderful letter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't expect Minori to pull a fast one on us like that... Nicely done.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori. We'll treasure everything you said.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe... I'm glad you liked it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Operation: Surprise The Surprisers was a big success!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Minori! We watched your stream. I was glad to see you having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And all those heartwarming comments! Reading them even made me tear up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good to see you've got such great fans. The stream was pretty fun too, so I guess it was a good birthday all around.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let us throw you another party when we get back from the US! We have to make up for missing the first one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. I hope you'll tell us all about that one, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Minori! Did you enjoy your party the other day?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm so glad you liked the cake we thought up. And the marzipan figures, too. We put a lot of effort into making those.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, your reaction was great. Seeing you so happy made it all worth it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You liked them so much you didn't even want to eat them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday again. I imagine you'll be busy with work a lot, but let's have lunch together again soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Minoriii! Happy wonderhoy birthday! Wasn't it such a warm and fuzzy and happy party?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good job on your birthday stream, too. That present quiz segment was fun, and I was really moved by your letter.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A birthday party and a birthday stream! How wonderful to be celebrated by so many!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let me add my voice to theirs! Hanasato, happy birthdaaay!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Happy birthday from me as well, Hanasato. May this year be a fine and fulfilling one for your work. I'll be cheering you on from the wings, myself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hanasato. I watched your stream with everyone from my group. It was very energetic and fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, the cheer was infectious. Every time you did anything, Mizuki and Ena loved it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can you blame me? She was swinging from nervous to excited and back, and she kept saying things were moving even though they weren't. It was funny.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That segment was laser-focused on all the things that make Minori great! Airi and the others really know their stuff!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that letter to your fans made me tear up, for real! I'm your fan for life, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Once again! Happy birthday, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't expect that reverse surprise you pulled on us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a little embarrassing that I didn't catch on at all, but it was a great surprise, and very you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it made me so happy! Thank you so much. I'll treasure this letter full of your kind words and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So will I. But really, if we're sharing thank yous, then we owe you a lot ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. You're always so positive, Minori, and it gives me the energy to keep on moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You always light up the room just by being there. I don't think you know just how much you do for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, thank you, Minori. Let's stay together for a long time to come.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I got so many birthday wishes from everyone at the party and on stream...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you for celebrating my birthday with me, too! I'm honestly overwhelmed by how much love I've gotten.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like just saying thank you hardly pays back any of your kindness and support...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I'll just have to deliver more and more and even more hope to you all!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much for today! See you again!
